name: Eleven Multilingual v2
access: ElevenLabs API: Text to Speech (HTTP, stream, WebSocket, multi-context WebSocket; the default model of the endpoint)

voice.output_audio: MP3 (22.05 kHz at 32 kbps, 24 kHz at 48 kbps, 44.1 kHz at 32 to 192 kbps), PCM 8 to 48 kHz 16-bit, WAV 8 to 48 kHz, Opus 48 kHz (32 to 192 kbps), mu-law 8 kHz and A-law 8 kHz; the default is mp3_44100_128; MP3 at 192 kbps needs the Creator plan or above, and PCM or WAV at 44.1 kHz needs Pro or above [el-api-tts]
voice.voices: custom cloning: library voices (the maker's pages give 3,000+, 10,000+ and 5,000+ as counts), instant and professional voice clones, and designed voices [el-tts-overview] [el-voices]
languages: 29 languages: English, Japanese, Chinese, German, Hindi, French, Korean, Portuguese, Italian, Spanish, Indonesian, Dutch, Turkish, Filipino, Polish, Swedish, Bulgarian, Romanian, Arabic, Czech, Greek, Finnish, Croatian, Malay, Slovak, Danish, Tamil, Ukrainian and Russian [el-models]
voice.interruption: Not handled by the model. The multi-context WebSocket lets a client close one context and open another when a user cuts in, with up to 5 contexts per connection [el-ws-multi]
voice.latency: The docs give no figure and say latency is higher than on the Flash models [el-models]; Artificial Analysis reports a median of 97.2 characters generated per second (throughput, not latency) [aa-tts-board]
voice.session_limit: 10,000 characters per request, about 10 minutes of audio [el-models]; the WebSocket closes after 20 seconds of inactivity unless the client sends a space; a multi-context socket allows up to 180 seconds [el-ws-tts] [el-ws-multi]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per character, not per token. API list price US$0.08 per 1,000 characters [el-pricing-api]. Artificial Analysis lists US$100 per 1M characters, which does not match the list price [aa-tts-ml2]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Elo (provider voice leaderboard)
benchmarks.setting: blind pairwise listener votes on ElevenLabs's own voices; the model page gives 1091.99 and the leaderboard table read the same day gives 1096.95

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis text-to-speech median characters per second
benchmarks.setting: median generation speed; read from the leaderboard data on the Artificial Analysis text-to-speech page

unknown: context_window: not applicable to a synthesis model; the limit is in characters, see voice.session_limit
max_output: not published in tokens; the per-request limit is 10,000 characters [el-models]
pricing_usd_per_mtok: the unit differs (US$ per 1,000 characters), see notes
